column3: ## Upload DOAJ XML where an author references multiple affiliations
Setup: Open /testdrive/multiple_affiliations in its own tab and keep it open (see the first test in this testset)
Setup: Copy the "doaj_xml" value from the testdrive "upload_data" section and save it as a file called multiple_affiliations.xml. It already contains the testdrive journal's ISSNs.
In a separate tab, log in with the testdrive publisher username and password
Choose "DOAJ Native XML" as the format, select multiple_affiliations.xml and click "Upload"

column4: A flash message is shown: "File uploaded and waiting to be processed. Check back here for updates."

column3: Wait a short time and reload the page

column4: The upload is shown as "successfully processed" with the note "1 articles imported (1 new, 0 updated)"

column3: Open the "journal_toc" link and click the article titled "XML Multiple Affiliations ..."

column4: The authors line reads "Jane Doe, John Smith" - each author appears once
"Jane Doe" shows an ORCiD link, then "University of Oxford" and "Harvard University" on separate lines
"John Smith" shows "Harvard University" and "MIT" on separate lines
"Harvard University" is shown under both authors, although it is defined only once in the XML file
